pregunta: cuál es nuestro comercio más importante
sql_referencia: SELECT m.trade_name, sum(s.fee_eur_minor) / 100.0 AS ingreso_bruto FROM fact_settlement_batch AS s JOIN v_merchant_current AS m ON m.merchant_id = s.merchant_id GROUP BY s.merchant_id, m.trade_name ORDER BY ingreso_bruto DESC LIMIT 1
